**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 7.6** is a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour (Fees to Customer no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms). Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and must not be redlined.
- No provision anywhere obliges Northwind to give Brightline terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, or to match third-party offers. I checked the pricing section (§ 7), agreement structure/scope (§ 2), and general terms (§ 30), and ran text searches for "no less favourable", "most favoured nation", "favourable", "parity", and "best terms".
- This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer), not merely the fallback.
